ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima Contagious Interview — node.exe / npm spawning Python or curl with BeaverTail → InvisibleFerret loader strings
ucs.description: Hunts the signature execution chain DPRK's Famous Chollima (CrowdStrike) uses in the Contagious Interview / fake-job-interview campaign: a developer runs `npm install` against a trojanized package, the embedded BeaverTail JavaScript executes inside node.exe, then drops/fetches the InvisibleFerret Python backdoor. The detection pivots on the parent (node/npm/npx) → child (python/curl/powershell) edge combined with known BeaverTail and InvisibleFerret C2/loader strings.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("python.exe","pythonw.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","cmd.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*ipcheck.cloud*" OR Processes.process="*api/contact*" OR Processes.process="*urllib.request*" OR Processes.process="*-c \"import*" OR Processes.process="*child_process*" OR Processes.process="*atob(*" OR Processes.process="*p.zi*" OR Processes.process="*api.npoint.io*" OR Processes.process="*beavertail*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LoaderStrings = dynamic(["ipcheck.cloud","/api/contact","urllib.request","child_process","p.zi","atob(","api.npoint.io","-c \"import","beavertail","invisibleferret"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("python.exe","pythonw.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (LoaderStrings)
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (LoaderStrings)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LoaderStrings = dynamic(["ipcheck.cloud","/api/contact","urllib.request","child_process","p.zi","atob(","api.npoint.io","-c \"import","beavertail","invisibleferret"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("\\node.exe","\\npm.exe","\\npx.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\\python.exe","\\pythonw.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\cmd.exe","\\curl.exe","\\wget.exe")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine has_any (LoaderStrings)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Famous Chollima Contagious Interview - Node.js Spawning Python/Curl With Loader Strings
id: 7d0a3a8e-4b6f-4e1d-9f70-5d4a1c7e2f01
status: experimental
description: Detects Node.js / npm / npx spawning Python, curl, or PowerShell with payload strings consistent with BeaverTail and InvisibleFerret loaders used in DPRK Famous Chollima fake-job-interview campaigns.
references:
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/famous-chollima-dprk-it-workers/
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/contagious-interview-lazarus-developers/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/11
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1204.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\npx.exe'
  child_selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  payload_selection:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ipcheck.cloud'
      - 'api/contact'
      - 'urllib.request'
      - 'child_process'
      - 'p.zi'
      - 'atob('
      - 'api.npoint.io'
      - '-c "import'
      - 'beavertail'
      - 'invisibleferret'
  condition: parent_selection and child_selection and payload_selection
falsepositives:
  - Internal build pipelines that pipe Node.js to Python for tooling. Tune via known build-agent allowlist.
level: high

ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima IT Worker scheme — multiple remote-control agents (AnyDesk + Chrome Remote Desktop + RustDesk) co-installed on a single deve
ucs.description: Hunts the operational fingerprint of DPRK Famous Chollima 'IT worker' insider operations, where a single fraudulently-hired developer endpoint is concurrently controlled via two or more remote-access utilities (typically AnyDesk plus Chrome Remote Desktop Host, often with RustDesk as fallback) so multiple Pyongyang operators can hand off shifts. Surfaces hosts running ≥2 distinct remote-control binaries within a 30-day window — a strong actor-specific signal that overlaps poorly with normal IT-support tooling.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process_name) as tools dc(Processes.process_name) as tool_count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","RustDesk.exe","chromeremotedesktophost.exe","remoting_host.exe","TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","LogMeIn.exe","Splashtop.exe","goverlanagent.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where tool_count >= 2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - tool_count
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let RemoteTools = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","chromeremotedesktophost.exe","remoting_host.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","logmein.exe","splashtop.exe","goverlanagent.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend BinLower = tolower(FileName)
| where BinLower in (RemoteTools)
| summarize ToolCount = dcount(BinLower),
            Tools     = make_set(BinLower),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| where ToolCount >= 2
| order by ToolCount desc, FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let RemoteTools = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","chromeremotedesktophost.exe","remoting_host.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","logmein.exe","splashtop.exe","goverlanagent.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend BinLower = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BinLower in (RemoteTools)
| summarize ToolCount = dcount(BinLower),
            Tools     = make_set(BinLower),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, TargetUserName
| where ToolCount >= 2
| order by ToolCount desc, FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\rustdesk.exe OR *\RustDesk.exe OR *\RUSTDESK.EXE OR *\chromeremotedesktophost.exe OR *\ChromeRemoteDesktopHost.exe OR *\remoting_host.exe OR *\TeamViewer.exe OR *\teamviewer.exe OR *\TeamViewer_Service.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\LogMeIn.exe OR *\Splashtop.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(anydesk|rustdesk|chromeremotedesktophost|remoting_host|teamviewer|teamviewer_service|screenconnect\.clientservice|logmein|splashtop|goverlanagent)\.exe$/i
| ImageBase := lower(regex_extract("([^\\\\]+)$", field=ImageFileName, group=1))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=ImageBase, distinct=true, as=tool_count), collect([ImageBase])])
| tool_count >= 2
